Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; exemptions and licensing bars resolve to the first selected page, identity, residence and license types to the second, class three, limited purpose, preliminary examinations and the card contents to the third, and the graduated program conditions to the fourth.

Confidence: high across the section; every rule is stated directly on its page, so part D raises no accuracy flag and routes nothing to role fifteen. One wording caution: the first page lists the permit-holding period in days and the second lists the provisional-holding period in months, and both are kept exactly as printed.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
